title: Fine grain / Blue dominant
description: Flat fine-grain gradient with blue across roughly 70% of the left and top, and lime diffusing from the lower right.
prompt: Create one standalone, full-bleed, high-quality landscape 16:9 background around 1672×941. This is a controlled visual material and color comparison, not a finished cover. No text, letters, symbols, objects, illustrations, people, scenery, logos, watermarks, frames, borders, panels or inset rectangles. Composition: approximately 70 percent saturated blue #007EBD/#168DDD occupying left, top and most of the center, softly transitioning into approximately 30 percent luminous lime #D6FF62 diffused through the lower-right corner. Preserve a simple broad diagonal color boundary from upper-right to lower-center. Make the dominant-color area truly blue, not mostly white or pale cyan. Use the provided image as the reference for the flat matte color transition and delicate, even fine analog grain. The image must remain purely flat and softly luminous with no discernible forms, refraction, glass, folds, fabric, rays, contours or gradients that look like objects. Keep this geometry clear so later edits can test color swaps against the same structure.
